Execution Guardrails & Policy Enforcement: Embed deterministic boundaries, authorization checks, rate/execution governors, and human-in-the-loop triggers directly into distributed data and execution paths. Auditable Governance & Traceability: Build immutable telemetry and lineage pipelines that capture runtime context, decisions, downstream side-effects, and state mutations to meet enterprise security and compliance standards. We staff sensibly, treat extra hours as the rare exception, and back that up with true schedule autonomy and remote flexibility—so your evenings stay yours. Turn data into insight: Deliver sharp balance sheet and P&L analyses, spotlighting trends and red-flag variances before anyone else sees them. Keep leadership laser-focused: Produce monthly variance reports against forecasts and annual plans, translating the findings into clear, action-ready recommendations, including cash runway and financing timing. Shape the roadmap: Guide annual budgets and rolling forecasts, aligning stakeholders around targets that push the business without breaking it. Step in as the “extra brain”: Handle special-project bookkeeping or period-end close entries when clients need a fractional controller’s precision and speed. Make audits painless: Design year-end audit plans, prep airtight support, and quarterback conversations with external auditors so CEOs and CFOs can sleep at night. Guard continuous disclosure: Stay ahead of regulatory changes, draft timely filings, and ensure nothing slips through the cracks on EDGAR. Result: clients see you as the calm, expert voice who keeps them compliant and strategic, while you build mastery across industries without the grind of traditional public practice . Requirements Our ideal candidate... CPA designation required. Significant public company audit and/or financial reporting experience – ideally with small to mid-sized reporting issuers listed in the US and reporting under US GAAP After the base experience requirements are met, we hire first and foremost, strong analytical and problem solvers. Code Quality: Participate in code reviews, testing, and technical design discussions, with an eye toward both security and maintainability. title: UI Engineer (Based in CA or NC only)
description: Mission: Live at the intersection of app runtime & security. Protect applications in a fundamental way so that developers can build great application services and not be constantly looking over their shoulder. BlueRock is changing the landscape of App runtime security. The role Location: Must be based in CA (preferably San Francisco Bay Area) or North Carolina You will work alongside BlueRock's product designers and the control plane development team on our operator consoles. These are the React front ends that engineers and security teams use to manage large fleets of protected nodes, see what AI agents are actually doing across those fleets, and author the policy that constrains them. The domain is AI and agentic systems, seen from the operations and security side. When an agent calls an MCP server, spawns a subagent, runs a shell command in a sandbox, or burns $40 of tokens in an afternoon, our UI is where a person sees it, understands it, and decides what to allow. So the interesting problems are visibility problems (how do you show a thousand agent sessions so someone can find the one that matters?) and control problems (how do you author an enforcement policy without a mistake taking production down?). This is a mid-level role. We expect about 3–5 years of professional front-end experience, or equivalent work that clearly shows the same judgment. The ideal candidate is passionate about user experience, design, and AI-assisted software development, with a demonstrated grounding in engineering best practices. The title says UI, but the work doesn’t stop there: you’ll work closely with our backend services, and a feature is finished when it’s proven working live, not when the screen looks right. Working with design delivered as code At BlueRock, product designers design and collaborate in code. Instead of handing off static mockups, they build working UI with AI coding tools, against real data, and open merge requests. Iteration happens so quickly that it has outpaced our capacity for robust engineering collaboration and review. This role closes that gap. You will collaborate directly with product designers and backend developers to keep UI development fast, by bridging the gap between vibe code and high-quality, sustainable, well-tested code. Some days that means reviewing and hardening a designer's branch so it can merge. Other days it means building the shared components, tests and guardrails that make the next branch need less hardening. Beyond reviewing and hardening code, you'll help shape how it gets made.
